notes.title: OMG - One More Goal - The full version 1.0 available now!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
it was a long journey, but in the end we managed to reach the goal: OMG - One More Goal has reached its final version 1.0!

In this latest mega-update the game has been completely rebuilt in all its parts, and has been made much more fluid, commercial and fun.

[previewyoutube=ZjRELdeNUr4;full][/previewyoutube]
Below we list all the news of version 1.0, hoping you like them!

New visual style
All the graphics in the game have been redesigned. Now the style is much more cheerful and cartoon style; lighting is more powerful and voxel technology has been abandoned to use simpler and more manageable structures.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/69ab76831bb8427d166f9560fa683a57d414c2bf.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/c1a2a9fcc1de92481bb14b52c645a724e9be1aa0.jpg

New procedural generation of levels
The random generation of levels has been completely overhauled. Voxel technology is no longer used but a much more flexible and simple structure is now used.
The vegetation and trees are created in a more orderly and clear way.
Dynamic obstacles have also been revised and are now procedurally generated based on levels. Trees and obstacles increase as you progress through the game campaign, creating an increasingly beautiful and unpredictable challenge.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/0f99e0546b62af0c12548a2e1c49d162de173bb5.jpg

New GUI
The whole graphic interface of the game has been completely rewritten, to be more readable, cheerful and commercial.
The in-game GUI has also been completely revised to use much more readable and clear cartoon effects.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/9949080ab5e060f74070ea17a281a77cfb28601e.jpg
New game statistics
The game statistics have been revised and modified, removing the less important ones and inserting those fundamental for the game dynamics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/141e1c74da8328a8ff8d0381d4043433bd27a129.jpg
New scoring system
The scoring system has also been completely revised.
We've added new rewards, new level stats, and additional scores now also take into account campaign difficulty, time played and actual match time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/15176b8edcdb0a2eefc2366f41b43f107c6ec822.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/2684a66675214e0dbd0938fa52cb03bfc4e44923.jpg
New multiple online leaderboards
Based on the new game statistics, the online rankings on Steam have also been changed, to have an increasingly fun and competitive challenge with other players from around the world!

Three endless game campaigns
With this full version of the game which has a new procedural generation of levels, vegetation and obstacles, only three main game campaigns have been maintained for now:
Forest, Grassland and Tropical.
In fact, the new game mechanics allow for guaranteed fun with these campaigns.
The standard edition of the game has the single Forest 1 campaign, the others are available as DLC.
Each campaign has different types of goals and obstacles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/0b199fb36a613af63882b3f8f02df7f15c486cb2.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/aa326b028df8d207ebea4520ad6dd2bdd6a80ee2.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/5b2ff692a4226a0d4737a422558a9c60ea114ebb.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/bd879f221f789f2598a65cbe73ed5e62a65a336b.jpg

We hope you enjoy the full game!

This was a very complicated period for us, we had many organizational problems but we were able to get back on the saddle!
We are working on a big update, the 'Refresh update', which will finally bring the game to the final version.

New graphic style
the whole graphic style of the game has been revolutionized, which is now much more cheerful and cartoonish.

notes.title: OMG - One More Goal! - Update 0.8.0 out NOW!!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
the world of little player robots evolves, and new scenarios are opening up on the horizon.
The playing fields are enriched with new items, new unexpected events, new weapons and new mechanical balls!
Now rival teams look for new ways to win!

[previewyoutube=57eAZAuGqQU;full][/previewyoutube]
New campaigns
Six fantastic new game campaigns have been added, with the option to start the main campaign which will explore all possible game scenarios (Full tour)!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/2af58f2bfd36deaafe328263dc76bad54c10f82b.png
New balls
New game balls have been added, all with different shapes and various physical characteristics.
In this way the game dynamics will vary depending on the scenario and you will have to find new game tactics!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/0a1cb6d6fadba0e079e8b182f80ed6c9363470b1.png
New bullets
New weapons and bullets have been added for the various campaigns, all with different characteristics for always different fights.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/76ebe4da742dfedbee2711c4f9cf4abfd3b6ffae.png
New obstacles
New dynamic obstacles have been added in front of the enemy goal, to increase the defense of the energy sources.
These obstacles vary by campaign, have various shapes and physical characteristics, and will need to be moved to score!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/b55ff03b15c738fb85fb3e3e2d9ed1ac8160a1a6.png
New score multiplier
Depending on the difficulty of the campaign there will be a score multiplier.
In this way the rewards will be balanced according to the type of game path chosen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/90985bf7e0599f9b2e7fc3eead5df947f88c2e9b.png
Road map
The next update will be dedicated to a different and revamped system of scores, rewards, match statistics and more!  

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update 0.7.0 now LIVE!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/684c66f5ea22f07daf470fa8ffcfde7fb1483ac4.png
Hello everyone!
Our journey begins with the first update that adds variety to the game campaigns.
We started testing the game's potential by adding new gameplay content and refining the basic structure.

[previewyoutube=cG28r9Xd-ts;full][/previewyoutube]
New campaigns!
Three new procedural campaigns have been added, easily selectable when starting a new game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/60758aedbb83cbea3393039a2a175281690b4a31.jpg
New ball!
These new campaigns contain a new game ball, heavier and with an irregular structure.
In this way the game dynamics become much more varied and with unpredictable difficulties.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/96a7d5e1b0824c191349779f09d03caa418add96.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/bf92e09dbe8566b94a02d7cd1a105f2dfbe8d0fe.png
New bullets!
With these new campaigns, players will have a new weapon at their disposal, with projectiles with a floating trajectory and variable size.
This changes the dynamics of combat in a more fun way!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/a30e52d5fa2290f24ec38d448dcc5dabf0d8f49c.png
New goals and multiple goalkeepers!
Much wider new goas have been added to these new campaigns, and these are defended by double goalkeepers.
This way you will have to find new techniques to score and pass the levels!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/5c3921c2ca2fea83ea98de585573b37032e386db.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38100921/4cd16f2b3319215a7711566c3357aed91c6cdc02.png
Game structure updates
- the flexibility and variety of the campaigns has been improved
- personalized balls have been enabled for each campaign
- customized weapons have been enabled for each campaign

Enjoy!
